questions.question: Mahatma Gandhi Antarashtriya Hindi Vishwavidalaya is located in ________________.
Who among the following Chief Justices of India was elected as the Vice President of India in 1979?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Justice M Hidayatullah) है।

questions.question: Which of the following rivers rises west of the Rohtang Pass in the Kullu hills of Himachal Pradesh and flows through the Chamba valley of the state?
The Iron and Steel Industry requires which of the following raw materials for production?
options: Iron ore, copper and lime stone
Iron ore, coking coal and lime stone
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Iron ore, coking coal and lime stone) है।

questions.question: Which of the following nutrients is present in raw potato?
Which of the following cities was the venue for the SAFF Junior Athletics Championships 2024?
What does private final consumption expenditure (PFCE) represent in the calculation of GDP?
options: The total value of goods and services consumed by households in an economy
The total amount of money circulating in an economy at a given point in time
The total government spending on public infrastructure projects
The total value of exports minus imports in a country's economy
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (The total value of goods and services consumed by households in an economy) है।

questions.question: Select the correct formula of national income.
options: Household consumption + Government expenditure + Investment + Export − Import
Household consumption + Government expenditure − Investment + Export − Import
Household consumption + Government expenditure + Investment − Import − Export
Household consumption + Government expenditure + Investment + Import − Export
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Household consumption + Government expenditure + Investment + Export − Import) है।

questions.question: Who among the following players led the 28-member Indian athletics contingent at the Paris Olympics in July-August 2024?

What is the primary function of Parliamentary Committees?
options: To manage the day-to-day administration of the country
To assist the Parliament in its legislative and deliberative functions
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (To assist the Parliament in its legislative and deliberative functions) है।

questions.question: Which social reform movement was started by Raja Ram Mohan Roy in Bengal?

Volcanic eruptions and related seismic activity
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Volcanic eruptions and related seismic activity) है।

options: Ensuring free legal services for the poor
Reducing inequalities in income and status

questions.question: Which of the following is a major source of renewable energy in India?
Which of the following is NOT an objective of the Samudrayaan mission, to be launched in 2026?
options: Strengthening India’s position in global ocean research and diplomacy
Collecting deep-sea samples related to marine biodiversity
Demonstrating India’s engineering capabilities in high-pressure underwater vehicles
Deploying satellite-based systems for underwater communication and surveillance
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Deploying satellite-based systems for underwater communication and surveillance) है।
